title: Develop Interactive Cost Calculator
description: Build a real-time cost calculator that shows importers all fees, duties, and taxes as they input shipment details. Include breakdowns by cost category with explanatory tooltips.

title: Create Cost Transparency Documentation
description: Develop comprehensive documentation explaining all cost components, calculation methods, and regulatory requirements. Make it accessible through the help center and in-app.

title: Implement Customer Satisfaction Survey System
description: Deploy automated surveys after key interactions to gather feedback on service quality, platform usability, and customer satisfaction. Use insights to drive continuous improvement.

title: Launch Proactive Customer Support Program
description: Establish a proactive support approach where the team reaches out to customers before issues escalate. Monitor account activity and provide guidance during critical import milestones.

title: Build Digital Onboarding Workflow
description: Create a step-by-step digital onboarding process with document upload, verification, and approval workflows. Include progress tracking and automated notifications.

title: Develop Onboarding Video Tutorial Series
description: Produce short, engaging video tutorials that guide new importers through platform features, document requirements, and best practices. Make them available in multiple languages.

title: Create Auction Analytics Dashboard
description: Build an interactive dashboard showing historical auction data, price trends, success rates, and market insights. Provide filtering by product category, time period, and region.

title: Implement Bidding Strategy Recommendation Engine
description: Develop a machine learning model that analyzes historical auction outcomes and suggests optimal bidding strategies. Provide confidence scores and explanations.

title: Design Customer Communication Templates
description: Create professional email and notification templates for all customer touchpoints including welcome messages, status updates, and follow-ups. Ensure consistent branding and tone.

title: Establish Monthly Customer Feedback Forums
description: Organize monthly virtual forums where customers can share feedback, ask questions, and learn about new features. Use insights to inform product roadmap.
